rationale: Not complete. T056 proves cleanup, 4 E2E, and 4 accessibility passes, but visual checks failed all three targets: 5,548 light pixels, 36% mobile difference with 390x3579 expected versus 6630 actual, and 8,183 dark pixels; build was not run. The current output still has provenance-pending generic media and materially different responsive composition. Existing snapshots are stale and unapproved. Raster/font provenance and the broader brief remain incomplete.

worker_package.objective: Implement one homepage source-fidelity slice aligning the existing truthful homepage data with the supplied desktop, mobile, dark-mode, and brand references. Correct hero, audience, project, principles, news, newsletter, header, footer, card treatment, spacing, responsive behavior, and dark-theme styling while retaining deterministic provenance-pending media placeholders. Do not add facts, raster media, fonts, registries, snapshots, external URLs, or unrelated workstreams.
verify: Before each Playwright command: inspect 127.0.0.1:3101 and proceed only when FREE or owned by this workspace.

pnpm exec prettier --check apps/web/src/app/page.tsx apps/web/src/app/globals.css apps/web/src/components/hero-illustration.tsx apps/web/src/components/project-card.tsx apps/web/src/components/site-header.tsx apps/web/src/components/site-footer.tsx
Compare fresh light desktop, 390px mobile, dark-mode, and brand-board output with supplied plans/assets references; do not run visual:update or approve mismatched baselines.
Confirm writes are limited to the listed source files, apps/web/.next, and test-results.
stop_if: Any write is needed outside allowed_files, especially content registries, design-system tokens, plans, reports, snapshots, docs-ingestion, search, hardening, operations, or external systems.
Raster media, font loading, licenses, GitHub URLs, news, project facts, or institutional claims would need to be invented or inferred.
The worker runs visual:update, modifies snapshots, weakens assertions, or treats stale-baseline mismatch as acceptance.
Fresh output introduces material responsive overflow, accessibility, functional, logo, or dark-mode regression against the supplied references.
Port 3101 is occupied by an unknown process or generated-output cleanup would traverse a symlink or broader directory.
A required command fails twice for the same in-scope cause.

evidence: T056 cleanup passed; pnpm e2e passed 4 tests and pnpm a11y passed 4 tests, while visual:check failed all 3 targets.
T056 visual results: light 5,548 differing pixels; mobile expected 390x3579 versus actual 390x6630 with 36% difference; dark 8,183 pixels.
Fresh test-results contains actual, expected, and diff images; desktop and dark captures are 1280x720.
Current homepage renders existing publicProjects and publishedNews with provenance-pending media slots, but differs from the reference composition.
Current project and hero components use generic deterministic placeholders; the header lacks the reference GitHub action and the footer is simpler.
The supplied homepage specification requires up to six image-led projects, responsive one-column mobile cards, a dark principles panel, news cards, and a complete public-institution footer.
apps/web/public contains only dark/light SVG logos; no repository-backed raster media or font files are present.

parallel_safety.reason: Homepage markup, shared stylesheet, shell components, generated runtime output, browser server ownership, and visual evidence are one coupled boundary; use one sole Worker.
